entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6412595290592307840 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0. Gaia DR3 source 6412595290592307840: parallax 274.8431 +/- 0.0956 mas (RUWE 1.15), inverted to 3.6384 pc with no zero-point correction. Gaia DR3 source 6412595290592307840: pmRA* 3966.6605 mas/yr, pmDec -2536.1920 mas/yr. Gaia DR3 source 6412595290592307840: -40.43 +/- 0.13 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, temperature and mass
entries.finding: As Sanghi et al. (2026), AJ, tabulate them (Table 1): radius from interferometry (Rains et al. 2020; Creevey et al. 2023), mass from asteroseismology (Lundkvist et al. 2024).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: The Gaia DR3 BP/RP sampled spectrum of source 6412595290592307840 (De Angeli et al. 2023, A&A 674, A2; Montegriffo et al. 2023, A&A 674, A3), weighted by the CIE 1931 2° color-matching functions (CIE 2019, CC BY-SA 4.0). No image of the star's surface exists.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,700 K and log g 4.63 (u1 0.736, u2 0.053): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/eps-indi-a.json: 4.625.
